newsitem.title: UK: Eagles falls as head coach Larder departs.
newsitem.headline: Eagles falls as head coach Larder departs.

text.p: Shares in newly floated Eagles Plc, owner of the Rugby League club Sheffield Eagles, dipped on Thursday after the departure from the club of head coach Phil Larder, dealers said.
Eagles shares, listed on Wednesday at 40p on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM), fell 2-1/2p to 31p by 1015 GMT in thin volume.
The company said Larder, who also coaches the Great Britain squad, had "agreed to leave the club by mutual consent" and has been replaced by John Kear, previously the assistant coach.

The departure of Larder and subsequent promotion of Kear follows a run of poor performances on the field by Sheffield Eagles, who have won only three out of 10 matches in the European Super League this season.
